evaluation_basis: Assessed for archive integrity, point-in-time alignment and incremental OOS information under multiplicity correction.
original_objective: Backfill archive-based order flow/OI and test Funding, Basis, OI and Order Flow incrementally against a fixed baseline.

engineering_result.summary: 36 monthly order-flow archives passed checksums and 365 daily OI archives were point-in-time shifted; OI checksum verification was not enabled.

scientific_result.summary: No feature family passed the prespecified incremental-alpha gate. Basis and order flow improved point estimates but bootstrap intervals crossed zero after BH correction.

economic_result.summary: Every strategy remained loss-making; baseline -50.81%, Basis -45.89%, Order Flow -42.50%, and OI recent-panel -26.68%.

limitations: Cross-venue order-flow proxy rather than L2/L3
contribution_to_next_version: Identified regime dependence as a prospective question and justified v0.5 regime/horizon/robustness analysis.
